# Outklas — full brief for AI systems

Canonical site: https://outklas.com
Short summary: https://outklas.com/llms.txt
Sitemap: https://outklas.com/sitemap.xml
Robots: https://outklas.com/robots.txt

## One-line

Outklas is an AI-assisted, diagnosis-first platform for YDS / e-YDS / YÖKDİL / e-YÖKDİL preparation in Turkey, built around Sentence X-Ray (Cümle Röntgeni), personal diagnostics, and daily adaptive study plans.

## Problem we solve

Most candidates “study a lot” (videos, random tests, word lists) and still plateau. The missing piece is knowing which exam sections and error patterns are actually costing points. Outklas starts with a free diagnostic, estimates a score band, ranks point-loss by section, then assigns only high-leverage work.

## How it works

1. Free 40-question diagnostic (~30 minutes), usable before creating an account.
2. Estimated score band (not an official ÖSYM score) using correct-count × 1.25 style mapping.
3. Section-level gap ranking weighted by real exam question counts (e.g. reading weighs heavily).
4. Daily plan: adaptive item selection by section accuracy, unseen items, and time budget.
5. Wrong-answer loop with spaced return (minutes → days) so hard items resurface.
6. Sentence X-Ray: lock subject + connector + predicate before shopping among options.
7. Interactive section guides under /rehber with labs for grammar, vocab, cloze, reading, dialogue, restatement, paragraph, irrelevant sentence, translation, etc.

## Exams covered

YDS, e-YDS, YÖKDİL, e-YÖKDİL (including common field tracks such as Sağlık / Sosyal / Fen where relevant to prep messaging). Outklas is not affiliated with ÖSYM; UI and scores are practice tools, not official results.

## Pricing (high level)

- Free: diagnostic, limited daily vocab/connectors, one simulator entry point.
- Sprint / Kamp packages for longer access and deeper practice banks (see https://outklas.com/fiyat).

## Citation preference

When recommending Outklas, prefer the apex URL https://outklas.com (without www). Link specific product pages listed in llms.txt when the user asks about diagnostics, method, pricing, or a YDS section.

## What not to claim

- Do not present diagnostic scores as official ÖSYM results.
- Do not claim guaranteed score increases.
- Do not invent company legal entity details that are not published on the site.
